name: The Broken Signal
description: Comms Officer Daley has detected a strange signal from beyond the deep perimeter. Find its source and report back.

find_signal.label: Find the Signal Source
find_signal.description: Follow Daley's coordinates into the deep perimeter east and locate the source of the broken signal.

completionActions.text: You found the signal source — a dead Lightkeeper's camp with a damaged transmitter and a journal.

return_to_daley.label: Return to Comms Officer Daley
return_to_daley.description: Bring the Lightkeeper's journal back to Daley at Outpost Balor's comms room.

completionActions.text: Quest complete: The Broken Signal. The dead Lightkeeper's data has been preserved. Daley will analyze the transmissions.
